Types

DrawOp = object
  case kind*: DrawOpKind
  of moveTo, lineTo:
    to*: DrawPoint           ## Endpoint.
  of quadraticTo:
    qCtrl*, qTo*: DrawPoint  ## Control point and endpoint.
  of cubicTo:
    c1*, c2*, cTo*: DrawPoint ## First control, second control, and endpoint.
  of closePath:
    nil
Path operation with kind-specific points. Discriminated by kind. 
DrawOpKind = enum
  moveTo,                   ## Move the pen without drawing.
  lineTo,                   ## Draw a straight segment.
  quadraticTo,              ## Draw a quadratic curve.
  cubicTo,                  ## Draw a cubic curve.
  closePath                  ## Close the current subpath.
Path operations, mirroring HarfBuzz draw funcs. 
DrawPoint = tuple[x, y: int32]
Integer outline point. 
GlyphOutline = object
  contours*: seq[OutlineContour] ## Outline contours.
Decoded glyph outline. 
OutlineBuilder = object
  contours*: seq[OutlineContour] ## Finished contours.
  cur*: seq[OutlinePoint]    ## Open contour under construction.
Incremental outline collector. 
OutlineCache = ref object
  items*: Table[uint32, Option[GlyphOutline]] ## Cached outlines by glyph id.
  order*: seq[uint32]        ## Insertion order for FIFO eviction.
  maxItems*: int             ## Maximum entries before eviction.
Lazily filled per-glyph outlines in font units, shared by copies of the owning ShaperFont. Failures are cached as none so repeated queries on malformed data do not re-decode. Bounded FIFO: the oldest entry is evicted once maxItems is exceeded, so CJK-sized fonts cannot grow the table without limit. 
OutlineContour = object
  points*: seq[OutlinePoint] ## Contour points in order.
  closed*: bool              ## True when the contour is closed.
One outline contour. 
OutlinePoint = object
  x*, y*: int32              ## Coordinates in font units.
  onCurve*: bool             ## True for on-curve points.
Contour point.
